$description: Which token each UI role uses. Read off the component rules in pocket-nutrition-design/foundations/pocket-nutrition.css — every entry corresponds to a real CSS rule, so this file records decisions already made rather than proposing new ones. tokens.json says what the values ARE; this says where they GO, which is the part a porter cannot infer from a palette alone.

$extensions.pn.alphaNotation: Some rules use an alpha of a token rather than a token itself (rgba(62, 122, 78, 0.08) is brand.leaf at 8 %). Those are written as {"token": "...", "alpha": 0.08}, because DTCG has no syntax for an alpha of a reference. Resolve as: take the token's RGB, apply the alpha, composite over the current surface.
$extensions.pn.tokenRefs: Every "token" value is a dotted path into tokens.json. scripts/emit_tokens.py fails if one does not resolve, so a typo cannot ship.

accent.$description: Reserved for a genuinely distinct secondary action. The foreground is pure white here, NOT paper — the only place in the system that uses #fff for text.

cream.$description: As default, but on the secondary surface.

dark.$description: Inverted card. Drops the border entirely — a hairline on a dark fill reads as an artefact.

badge.$description: Small status/category chips: pill radius, weight 700, size 0.68rem, letter-spacing 0.02em. Each variant pairs a *Soft background with its matching onSoft foreground — never the base hue as text, which fails contrast on its own tint.

outline.$description: Means 'provisional / unverified'. The dashed border IS the signal, so a port must keep the dash — solid makes it read as an ordinary badge.

filterPill.$description: Toggleable filter chip. Three distinct states; hover changes border AND text, not just one of them.

focus.$description: Focused fields use the BRAND green, unlike every other focusable element, which uses the accent focus ring. Both behaviours are in the stylesheet; keep the distinction rather than unifying them.

progress.$description: Segmented accuracy bar. The segment colours are NOT the status tokens throughout: the middle segment is brand.carrot, not status.warn. Transcribed as-is rather than normalised.

nav.$description: Sticky translucent header. The blur is load-bearing — without it the 90 % paper fill lets content show through as mud. On Android use a scrim if a real blur is too costly; on iOS an ultra-thin material background is the direct equivalent.

logoMark.$description: The one accent-coloured glyph in the wordmark.

display.$description: Headings. The tight line-height and negative tracking are what make this read as editorial rather than default-serif; a port that drops them loses the character.

emphasis.$description: Italic inside a heading, coloured brand green. This is the system's main expressive device — the emphasised word in a headline.

kicker.$description: Small uppercase label above a heading.

focusRing.$description: Applies to buttons and filter pills. Text inputs use their own brand-green treatment instead — see input.focus.

confidence.$description: How a prediction's confidence maps to a colour. TRANSCRIBED FROM THE SANDBOX (src/components/results/NutritionResults.tsx, confidenceColor) and re-pointed at brand tokens, because the sandbox states it in Tailwind classes that mean nothing natively. The THRESHOLDS are the contract and must not drift between clients: a user comparing the two apps on the same meal has to see the same badge. Lower bound inclusive, evaluated top to bottom.
